description: This file defines the external API functions for the Daemon Server UDP Object in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It contains prototype declarations for functions related to managing host address, ports, worker objects, socket and packet pools, engine pools, and processing methods for UDP communication. The file serves as an internal API header for components within the system, providing the interface for interaction with the UDP server object.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetHostAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the host address used by the daemon server UDP object.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetHostAddress
methods.description: Sets the host address for the daemon server UDP object.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetHostPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port number used by the UDP server.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetHostPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the UDP server.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetWorker
methods.description: Obtains the worker object associated with the UDP server.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetWorker
methods.description: Assigns a worker object to the UDP server with specified size.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetMaxMessageSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum message size supported by the server.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetMaxMessageSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum message size the server can handle.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetEngineCount
methods.description: Gets the number of engine instances available.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetEngineCount
methods.description: Sets the number of engine instances.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetMinSocketCount
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of sockets configured.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetMinSocketCount
methods.description: Configures the minimum number of sockets.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetMaxSocketCount
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of sockets allowed.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetMaxSocketCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of sockets.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetMinPacketCount
methods.description: Gets the minimum number of packets.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetMinPacketCount
methods.description: Sets the minimum number of packets.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetMaxPacketCount
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of packets.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetMaxPacketCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of packets.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetSocketTimeOut
methods.description: Gets the timeout value for socket operations.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetSocketTimeOut
methods.description: Sets the timeout value for socket operations.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetPacketTimeOut
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout value for packet operations.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetPacketTimeOut
methods.description: Sets the timeout value for packet operations.

methods.name: AnscDsuoGetMode
methods.description: Gets the current operational mode.

methods.name: AnscDsuoSetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode.

methods.name: AnscDsuoReset
methods.description: Resets the UDP server object to default state.

methods.name: AnscDsuoAcceptTask
methods.description: Handles accepting incoming UDP connection requests.

methods.name: AnscDsuoWorkerTask
methods.description: Performs work for a UDP socket in a worker thread.

methods.name: AnscDsuoEngage
methods.description: Engages the UDP server, initializing necessary components.

methods.name: AnscDsuoCancel
methods.description: Cancels current operations and shuts down the UDP server.

methods.name: AnscDsuoStartEngines
methods.description: Starts processing engines for UDP communication.

methods.name: AnscDsuoStopEngines
methods.description: Stops processing engines.

methods.name: AnscDsuoAcquireSocket
methods.description: Acquires a socket from the pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoManufactureSocketPool
methods.description: Creates the socket pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoDestroySocketPool
methods.description: Destroys the socket pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoAcquirePacket
methods.description: Gets a packet from the pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoReleasePacket
methods.description: Releases a packet back to the pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoManufacturePacketPool
methods.description: Creates the packet pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoDestroyPacketPool
methods.description: Destroys the packet pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoAssignEngine
methods.description: Assigns an engine to process a packet.

methods.name: AnscDsuoManufactureEnginePool
methods.description: Creates the engine pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoDestroyEnginePool
methods.description: Destroys the engine pool.

methods.name: AnscDsuoQuery
methods.description: Processes a synchronous query on a socket.

methods.name: AnscDsuoProcessSync
methods.description: Processes incoming data synchronously.

methods.name: AnscDsuoProcessAsync
methods.description: Processes incoming data asynchronously.
